---
title: "Stats — Weekly coverage pattern"
description: "Average coverage per day of week (Sun=0..Sat=6)."
output: /data/weekly_pattern.json
format: array
---

Média de cobertura por dia da semana — útil para detectar quedas
estruturais (ex.: domingos sem publicação).

Um dia ainda **não settled** (mesmo critério `absent_confirmed`/`pending_real`
de `site_status.qmd` e `stats_coverage.qmd`: DJEN confirmou o caderno mas o
upload ainda não aconteceu, dentro do SLO de 24h de
`docs/SERVICE_OBJECTIVES.md`) é excluído da média do seu dia da semana --
caso contrário um dia que só ainda não terminou de processar diluiria a
média como se fosse uma queda de cobertura real.

```{sql}
WITH classified AS (
  SELECT
    date,
    tribunal,
    coalesce(CAST(ia_status AS VARCHAR), '') = 'uploaded' AS uploaded,
    coalesce(CAST(djen_raw AS VARCHAR), '') IN ('404', '400', 'no_publications') AS raw_absent
  FROM manifest
),
daily AS (
  SELECT
    date,
    COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE uploaded) AS collected,
    COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE NOT uploaded AND NOT raw_absent) AS unsettled
  FROM classified
  GROUP BY date
)
SELECT
  dow AS day_idx,
  CASE dow
    WHEN 0 THEN 'Sunday'
    WHEN 1 THEN 'Monday'
    WHEN 2 THEN 'Tuesday'
    WHEN 3 THEN 'Wednesday'
    WHEN 4 THEN 'Thursday'
    WHEN 5 THEN 'Friday'
    WHEN 6 THEN 'Saturday'
  END AS name,
  ROUND(AVG(collected), 2)::DOUBLE AS avg,
  COUNT(*) AS days_count
FROM (
  SELECT EXTRACT(DOW FROM date)::INTEGER AS dow, collected
  FROM daily
  WHERE unsettled = 0
)
GROUP BY dow
ORDER BY dow;
```
